title: [FIXTURE - synthetic test page, not a real article] Does the Eiffel Tower Grow in Summer?
text: Claim: The Eiffel Tower gets taller in the summer. Rating: True. Because iron expands when it heats up, the Eiffel Tower can grow by up to around 15 centimetres on hot days.
